content.user_title: Manage Lark Approvals with Guided CLI Workflows
content.value_statement: Lark approval operations require precise identifiers, scopes, and command parameters. This skill guides searches, submissions, status checks, and confirmed approval actions through lark-cli.
actual_capabilities: Search approval definitions that the current Lark user can start.
Retrieve approval definitions, form controls, options, and process nodes.
Create native approval instances after validating required form and node values.
Query pending or completed tasks and inspect instance details or progress.
Approve, reject, transfer, add signers, roll back, or remind approval tasks.
Cancel initiated approval instances and add copied recipients to an instance.
limitations: Requires lark-cli, valid Lark authentication, and the necessary approval scopes.
Cannot create or edit approval definitions.
Third-party approval definitions must use their create link instead of native submission.
Unsupported form controls may require the Lark client or approval administration interface.

use_cases.title: Submit an Employee Request
use_cases.description: Find a launchable definition, review required fields, and submit a confirmed leave or expense request.

use_cases.title: Process Pending Reviews
use_cases.description: List assigned approval tasks, inspect relevant details, and perform a confirmed approval decision.

use_cases.title: Monitor Approval Operations
use_cases.description: Track initiated instances, inspect progress, send reminders, or update recipients with validated identifiers.

prompt_templates.title: List Pending Approvals
prompt_templates.prompt: List my pending Lark approvals. Show each title, requester, status, instance code, and task ID. Do not change any approval.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare a Leave Request
prompt_templates.prompt: Find the launchable leave approval definition. Show its required fields and valid options, then ask me for every missing value before submission.

prompt_templates.title: Review and Approve a Task
prompt_templates.prompt: Find my pending expense approval for the specified requester. Summarize the form and current node, then request confirmation before approving it.

prompt_templates.title: Transfer a Specific Approval
prompt_templates.prompt: Prepare to transfer the specified approval task to the named colleague. Resolve the identifier, validate task support, preview the request, and execute only after confirmation.

output: Leave request from Chen Wei, awaiting your review.
Expense request from Li Na, awaiting your review.
Purchase request from Wang Jun, awaiting your review.

output_examples.input: Prepare my leave request for next Monday.
output_examples.output: I found the annual leave definition and reviewed its required fields. I still need the end time and leave reason before preparing confirmation.

output_examples.input: Approve the expense request after I confirm.
output_examples.output: The expense request is ready for approval. The target task, requester, amount, and comment are shown for final confirmation before execution.

best_practices: Use task and instance identifiers from fresh query results.
Preview write requests and confirm the target, action, and recipient before execution.
Read the relevant reference before supplying form controls or identity types.
anti_patterns: Do not guess approval codes, control IDs, task IDs, or user identifier types.
Do not execute approval writes without clear user intent and target confirmation.
Do not repeat failed write actions without checking the error and current state.

faq.question: What does this skill manage?
faq.answer: It searches definitions, submits native instances, queries tasks, inspects progress, and performs supported approval actions.

faq.question: Does it create approval definitions?
faq.answer: No. Create or edit approval definitions in the Lark client or approval administration interface.

faq.question: Can it submit third-party approvals?
faq.answer: No. Third-party definitions use their provided create link instead of the native instance creation command.

faq.question: Does it require confirmation for write actions?
faq.answer: Yes. Preview and confirm consequential actions such as submission, approval, rejection, transfer, rollback, cancellation, and copied recipients.

faq.question: Which user identifier should I provide?
faq.answer: Use open_id by default. Ensure each identifier matches the user_id_type sent with the command.

faq.question: What access is required?
faq.answer: The environment needs lark-cli, authenticated user access, and the Lark approval scopes required by each operation.
